description:
A data-loss hole in the first F1-3 slice, caught by re-reading the raw
carry rule against the write paths: GradeStore.put(GradeK)/remove()
re-rendered the grades section from the ADAPTABLE subset alone (the
parsed GradeK map), so once clip B carries a record this build cannot
express through GradeK (a node chain, an opendrt output — records
mapOfGrade honestly refuses), a plain save on clip A DROPPED clip B's
record from the file.

Both paths now route through writeRaw: the section renders from the
parsed FILE records, only the target clip's record swapped (the v2
put(ClipGradeV2) path's carry, applied to the v1 API too). The golden
raw-carry test pins the hole shut: a node+opendrt record survives a
GradeK save AND a remove on other clips, byte-verified through getV2.
